content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deployed initially for the period of six months which may be further extended based on requirements/performance. Empanelment means shortlisted candidates will be in the panel of NIELIT for one year.

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Net Banking/IMPS. Last date to pay the fee: 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIELIT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document Verification Interview / Interaction Interview/interaction and Document verification will be conducted at NIELIT Centre Janakpuri, Delhi for Delhi location.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original documents Self-attested photocopies of marksheets, degrees, testimonials Post qualification experience certificates including experience letter of current place of working Valid photo ID

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Go to the Google registration form link provided in the notification. Submit separate application for each post and requisite fee. Deposit non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 750/- per position through Net Banking/IMPS at the time of filling the Google form. Apply on or before 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: NIELIT does not guarantee to deploy all shortlisted candidates from panel. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in interview/document verification.
